entities.name: Selective aryl ester hydrolysis
observations: The reaction converts one aryl methyl ester, Ar-C(O)OCH3, to the corresponding carboxylic acid, Ar-C(O)OH.
The methyl alpha,beta-unsaturated ester remains intact; amide/urea carbonyls and the difluorochlorophenyl group are unchanged.
Apparent additional bond-order differences are primarily aromatic/kekule representation changes.

entities.name: LiOH water THF hydrolysis
observations: ORD precedent ord-3c0835b16fe3402c95ad8366215c8365 uses LiOH, water, and THF for 2.0 hours.
Acidic workup is implied for isolation of the carboxylic acid.

entities.name: Lithium hydroxide
observations: Most directly supported hydrolysis reagent for the supplied transformation, used with water and THF.
